RMS device templates

These templates model devices in the root-mean-square phasor domain. Select a template to inspect its purpose, equations, parameters, initialization, and interfaces.

The explicit-state RMS converter blocks reference covers the complete HVDC GFL VSC, its nine independently wireable components, and the R-L DC-line model. It includes the selectable Vdc/P and Qac/Vac control modes and the manual-assembly connections.
